title: Good starter set, but nearly 100% plastic.
text: Good starter set, but nearly 100% plastic.. These look great from a distance, and I like the grinding mechanism on the pepper mill, but the brushed nickel plated finish on the acrylic doesn't hid the fact that these are, in fact, plastic. As other reviewers have mentioned, the majority of the components are plastic, and I worry about longevity with frequent use (especially unscrewing / disassembling to clean / refill. They are also quite large / bulky, and the molding process leaves visible seams on the tops. This would be a great gift for a student headed out to college / for a first apartment, but for visual appeal and durability, I'll stick to my Peugeot grinder for the dining room table!
